title.en: A new example: following a missing address
title.zh: 原创例子：追一条缺少地址的消息

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者收到一张缺少入口说明的活动海报，先询问从哪扇门进入，而不猜测组织者为何省略。用通道图像，可以定位信息在哪里中断；得到地址后就能结束询问，无须把一次遗漏解释成谁内向、神秘或不够细心。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader receives an event notice without entrance instructions and asks which door to use, without guessing why the organiser omitted it. A channel image can locate an information gap. Once the address is clear, questioning can end without attributing secrecy, introversion or carelessness.

title.en: An optional reflection, available to every reader
title.zh: 所有读者都能选用的观察

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“消息缺的是哪项信息，一次澄清是否已经足够？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which information is missing, and would one clarification be enough?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.

title.en: Sources and the separate year calculation
title.zh: 来源与另行说明的节年计算

Colours prescribe no clothing, bodily condition or fortune; central Five adds no ninth trigram. Annual labels measure no personality, ability, maturity, human worth, compatibility or future. Historical diagrams and classical commentary supply cultural background, while NAOJ supplies Beginning of Spring boundaries. Astronomy endorses no personality or fortune claim. These original examples have no established personal predictive or psychometric validity. The page accepts only a Gregorian year from 1900–2026 and an explicit boundary-side selection. No complete date, birth time, location, sex or time zone is entered, and no birth-location conversion occurs. Clearly before the displayed JST boundary uses the previous season year; clearly after uses the entered year. Unknown dates, times, zones or conversions, and births within the displayed boundary minute, retain two possible labels and both full guides. Two results are neither personality halves, a confidence interval nor two fortunes. Choosing a preferred story cannot resolve uncertain timing. JST is UTC+09:00, shown to a minute, without replacing the boundary with February 4, January 1 or Lunar New Year. Year and side stay in page memory. Editing clears the old result; clearing, reloading, leaving or changing language removes inputs without added drafts or result caches. Copying includes only public guide titles and links, without year, side or operations. Discuss fictional people without disclosing birth information, accepting labels or undertaking an exercise. Disagreement or stopping is welcome.

title.en: A new example: the invisible work of a shared meal
title.zh: 原创例子：一顿聚餐背后的未显工作

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者参加共同野餐，把准备食物、带走垃圾与可用时间分别摆出来讨论。有人只能参加一小时，便选择一项可承担的工作，也可不接额外任务。承载图像帮助看见安排，不能把二星或某种家庭角色变成默认收尾者。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader joins a shared picnic and separates food preparation, waste collection and available time for discussion. Someone attending for one hour can accept a manageable task or decline another. A carrying image makes arrangements visible without assigning cleanup to label Two or a family role.

title.en: An optional question about a workable contribution
title.zh: 可选：怎样的投入才可承担

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“哪些支持工作尚未约定，谁可以自由接受或拒绝？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which supporting tasks remain unagreed, and who can freely accept or decline?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.

title.en: A new example: making a first draft visible
title.zh: 原创例子：把第一稿变成看得见的一步

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者想试办一次旧物交换，先画出一张可修改的场地草图，发现通道会被桌子挡住。第一步的价值在于显出实际问题，不在于更快或更勇敢。可以改图、等待确认，或取消计划；雷的图像不要求把想法立即变成行动。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader considers a swap event and sketches a revisable layout, revealing that a table would block a passage. The first step makes a practical problem visible rather than demonstrating speed or courage. Revising, awaiting confirmation or cancelling remain possible; a thunder image requires no immediate action.

title.en: An optional first step with a stopping point
title.zh: 可选：给第一步一个停止点

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“这个小步骤揭示了什么，接下来需要修改还是等待？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What did the small step reveal, and does the next decision need revision or waiting?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.

title.en: A new example: a change that reaches one shared routine
title.zh: 原创例子：一个改变怎样进入共同惯例

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者提出共用厨房的新标记，发现有人看不清颜色区分，便询问是否改用文字或形状。想法被听见、被理解与被接受是三件事。风的图像可帮助追踪传达过程，但不能把未采用建议解释成别人不配合，也不要求任何人迁就。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader suggests shared-kitchen labels and learns that colour distinctions are hard for someone to see. They ask whether words or shapes would help. Hearing, understanding and accepting an idea differ. A wind image can trace communication without equating an unused suggestion with uncooperativeness or requiring accommodation from anyone.

title.en: An optional check on how an idea travels
title.zh: 可选：看看一个想法怎样传开

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“建议到了谁那里，哪里不易理解，是否真的获得同意？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Who received the suggestion, what was unclear, and was there actual agreement?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.

title.en: A new example: a shared document as a connecting point
title.zh: 原创例子：把共同文档当作连接点

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者替小组维护活动信息表，标出哪些日期尚待场地确认，并让各负责人自行更新。文档位于信息中心，不意味着编辑者能替大家答应出席。中心图像只帮助看见依赖；五不比其他数字更重要，也不预告风险或要求控制。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader maintains an event sheet, marks dates awaiting venue confirmation and lets each responsible person update their part. A central document gives its editor no right to commit others to attendance. The centre image shows dependencies. Five ranks no higher than other numbers and predicts neither risk nor a need for control.

title.zh: 可选：画出依赖，也画出边界

paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which links are information dependencies, which involve decision rights, and have they been confused?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. title.en: A new example: a standard that helps a shared task
title.zh: 原创例子：一项真正帮助合作的标准

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者沿用一份活动检查表，发现联系渠道已改变，便与参与者商量删去旧项目、补上新信息。持续可以是持续服务实际需要，而非永久维护同一做法。天的图像不证明可靠程度，也不赋予制定规则的人更高身份。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader uses an event checklist, notices that contact channels changed and discusses replacing obsolete items. Continuity can mean continuing to serve a need, without preserving a method forever. A heaven image establishes neither reliability nor higher status for the person who wrote a rule.

title.en: An optional look at what a standard serves
title.zh: 可选：看清标准服务什么

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“这条标准现在服务什么需要，受影响的人能否提出修改？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What need does this standard now serve, and can affected people propose changes?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.

title.en: Sources and the separate year calculation
title.zh: 来源与另行说明的节年计算

paragraphs.zh: 补充情境与讨论提示由费马测试编辑部原创，任何标签的读者均可使用或略过。数字、色名、五行与卦象是不同的文化配属，不是量表维度；色名不指定穿衣、身体状况或吉凶，五居中也不增设第九卦。年度标签不测量人格、能力、成熟度、社会价值、配对或未来。历史图式与古典疏文提供文化背景，日本国立天文台提供立春界点；天文学不为人格或运势主张背书。本站原创例子尚无个人预测或心理测量效度。页面仅接受1900—2026年的公历年份与明确选择的界点前后；没有完整生日、出生时刻、地点、性别或时区输入，不自动换算出生地时间。明确在显示的JST界点之前用上一节年，之后用当年；生日、时刻、时区或换算不清楚，以及界点所示分钟内的出生，都保留两个可能标签与两篇全文。两个结果不表示人格各占一半、置信区间或两种运势，也不选更喜欢的标签来消除时间不确定性。表中的JST为UTC+09:00，显示到分钟，不用固定2月4日、元旦或农历新年替代。年份与界点选择只在本页内存；修改会清除旧结果，清除、刷新、离开或换语会移除输入，不新增草稿或结果缓存。复制仅公开指南标题与链接，不含年份、界点选择或算式。可只讨论虚构人物，无需披露出生信息、接受标签或完成练习；意见不同也可结束。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additional scenes and prompts for readers under any label to use or decline. Numbers, colour-names, phases and trigrams are distinct cultural correspondences, without measured dimensions. Colours prescribe no clothing, bodily condition or fortune; central Five adds no ninth trigram. Annual labels measure no personality, ability, maturity, human worth, compatibility or future. Historical diagrams and classical commentary supply cultural background, while NAOJ supplies Beginning of Spring boundaries. Astronomy endorses no personality or fortune claim. These original examples have no established personal predictive or psychometric validity. The page accepts only a Gregorian year from 1900–2026 and an explicit boundary-side selection. No complete date, birth time, location, sex or time zone is entered, and no birth-location conversion occurs. Clearly before the displayed JST boundary uses the previous season year; clearly after uses the entered year. Unknown dates, times, zones or conversions, and births within the displayed boundary minute, retain two possible labels and both full guides. Two results are neither personality halves, a confidence interval nor two fortunes. Choosing a preferred story cannot resolve uncertain timing. JST is UTC+09:00, shown to a minute, without replacing the boundary with February 4, January 1 or Lunar New Year. Year and side stay in page memory. Editing clears the old result; clearing, reloading, leaving or changing language removes inputs without added drafts or result caches. Copying includes only public guide titles and links, without year, side or operations. Discuss fictional people without disclosing birth information, accepting labels or undertaking an exercise. Disagreement or stopping is welcome.

title.en: A new example: checking what makes a gathering pleasant
title.zh: 原创例子：确认聚会怎样才令人舒适

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者和朋友讨论聚会，有人想聊天，有人想安静参与，大家选择可自由离开的短活动。悦可以引出不同偏好的讨论，不要求每个人看起来开心。七赤之赤不是火行，泽象也不让任何人承担主持、消费或安抚全场的任务。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader discusses a gathering with friends: some want conversation, others quiet participation. They choose a short activity people can leave freely. Delight can invite different preferences without requiring visible happiness. Red in Seven’s name does not make its phase Fire, and a lake image assigns no hosting, spending or soothing duty.

title.en: An optional expression with room for another answer
title.zh: 可选：表达偏好，也留出别的答案

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“谁喜欢哪种参与方式，不参与或提前离开是否同样被接受？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which ways of participating are preferred, and are declining or leaving early equally accepted?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.

title.en: A new example: ending one task before accepting another
title.zh: 原创例子：接下一件事之前先结束眼前一步

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者整理共用照片时收到新邀请，先记下已完成的文件夹，再决定是否接受下一项任务。暂停有一个具体用途，不必变成无限拖延；也可以直接行动。山的图像不证明固执或耐心，更不能要求别人永远维持原来的安排。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader receives an invitation while organising shared photos, records the completed folder and then decides whether to accept the next task. A pause can serve a purpose without becoming indefinite delay; immediate action is also possible. A mountain image proves neither stubbornness nor patience and requires no permanent arrangement.

title.en: An optional pause with a defined purpose
title.zh: 可选：给暂停一个明确用途

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“暂停要保存或确认什么，什么信息会支持继续或改变？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What needs recording or checking during the pause, and what information would support continuing or changing?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.

title.en: A new example: a clear demonstration reveals a gap
title.zh: 原创例子：一次清楚展示也会显出缺口

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者演示如何填写一张活动表，朋友指出示例没有说明可以留空的字段。双方修改说明，而不是把演示流畅当作内容已经正确。火的图像可比喻问题显出来，不证明谁更聪明、应获赞赏，也不要求公开展示个人经历。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader demonstrates an activity form. A friend notices that the example omits which fields can be left blank, so they revise it instead of treating a fluent presentation as proof of correctness. Fire can illustrate something becoming visible without implying intelligence, deserved praise or a duty to display personal experience.

title.en: An optional demonstration with room for correction
title.zh: 可选：做一次允许纠正的展示

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“展示让什么变得可见，还有哪些遗漏需要核对？”可以只谈虚构人物，把观察、解释与未知分开。参与者可拒绝或结束，不用展示个人结果、出生资料或私事，也不以讨论给他人分配责任。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What became visible through the demonstration, and which omissions still need checking?” Discuss fictional people, separating observation, interpretation and unknowns. Participants may decline or stop without showing personal results, birth information or private affairs. Discussion assigns no responsibilities to anyone.
